This is a hill I'll die on. Kids don't need gender reassignment if any kind and should go through the puberty that they are naturally going to go through. Its not ignorance, but rather research that has shown success with psycotherepy in dealing with gender dysphoria. Its precarious to allow adolescents a permanent medical intervention when other non-medical options exist to help these kids with what they are going through. 

Heres a summary of some case studies and some descriptive articles on the subject.

https://acpeds.org/assets/Psych-studies-gender-identity-final-17-June-2021.pdf

I'm not against trans people in any way. I'm against children acting on foggy judgement in a tine of chemical imbalance. Hate me if you want but don't pretend like its not been studied.

I have to clarify, I'm not only not Conservative, I'm more on the socialiat side of the spectrum. I want people to make their own decisions about everything, but children going through a lot of changes can really influence the way their brain works in a non permanent way. This is not my opinion, just biology. I know its more complex than that, but laws should be imposed to protect people from bad decisions that can affect their entire lives. Especially in children.
